tasks.title: Six o'clock sweep [wizloop:unchanged]
tasks.prompt:
[wizloop:unchanged] A scheduled run of the loop file adapters/fixtures/t3/unchanged.md. Do these steps in order. TIME below means the time now in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

1. Do this:
Sweep the stalled work and say why each item is stalled.

2. Last, append `TIME unchanged ok WHAT` to .openwiz/home/unchanged/ok.log, where WHAT is one line saying what you did; or, if step 1 failed, `TIME unchanged failed WHY`.
